description: The dashboard's daily metric history for a repository, oldest day first, for trends: is CI getting slower or failing more, is the backlog growing, are runners congested more often? Each day carries what the dashboard recorded that day: issues filed and closed and open, CI runs passed and not passed, active agents, delivery counts (in progress, blocked, under an initiative, on the project board with a Status), and runner capacity (time congested out of time measured). Give days (1 to 90, default 14) and, to keep the answer short, sections. Counts only. Read-only, and it never fails: if the history cannot be read, or the dashboard keeps none, it says why.

days.description: How many days back, today included (default 14, at most 90).

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

sections.description: Only these sections: issues, ci, agents, delivery, capacity (default all).

name: metrics_history
title: Daily metric history, for trends
